events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: MTV launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed the Radio Star' as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV Impact
angles.copy: Remember the day music television changed everything? MTV launched on this day in 1981, kicking off with The Buggles. Did video really kill the radio star?

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album, 'Definitely Maybe,' on August 29, 1994, becoming the fastest-selling debut album in British history at the time.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Impact
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe'. What's your favourite track from the album that launched a Britpop phenomenon?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, hundreds of thousands gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. What's your ultimate festival memory?

events.title: Elvis Presley Tribute
events.blurb: Elvis Presley passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, who we lost on this day in 1977. His music lives on.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Jimi Hendrix, who left us on this day in 1970. His guitar mastery continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road,' on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in music history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic frontwoman of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a Britpop icon, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam G Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Imagine UK Release
angles.copy: On this day in 1975, John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK. A message that still resonates today.

events.title: First iPod Release Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple released the first generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago today, Apple unveiled the original iPod. Suddenly, 1,000 songs in your pocket was a reality. Did you have one of the originals?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No,' on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating the enduring legacy of 007 since 'Dr. No' premiered on this day in 1962. What's your favourite Bond theme?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece – what's your go-to track from it?
